d: Head of Real Estate will lead the strategy, development, and management of the company’s real estate portfolio and physical infrastructure. The role oversees site acquisition, leasing, engineering design, construction delivery, and ongoing facilities operations across offices, operational sites, warehouses, and commercial locations. The position requires strong leadership across real estate development, engineering governance, construction execution, and facilities management.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Real Estate, or a related field
12+ years of experience in real estate development, construction management, engineering, or infrastructure operations
Proven experience delivering large-scale construction or infrastructure projects
Strong expertise in tendering, procurement, and contractor management
Experience managing multidisciplinary teams across engineering, construction, and facilities
Strong understanding of construction processes, engineering systems, and building regulation
Master’s degree in Engineering, Real Estate Development, Construction Management, or Business Administration
Professional certifications such as PMP, RICS, or Chartered Engineer
Experience managing logistics facilities, warehouses, or multi-site operational infrastructure
Strong financial modeling and capital planning skills for infrastructure investments
Familiarity with sustainability standards and energy-efficient building systems
